requirements.text: The rear lamp shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
requirements.quote: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.

requirements.text: All markings on the rear lamp shall be clearly legible.
requirements.quote: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible,

requirements.text: All markings on the rear lamp shall be indelible.
requirements.quote: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible,

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking on the rear lamp, the value for "a" shall be at least 5 mm.
requirements.quote: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for "a" shall be at least 5 mm.

requirements.text: The approval marking of the rear lamp shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.quote: The approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.

requirements.text: The approval marking of the rear lamp shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.quote: The four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.

requirements.text: The sequential number of the approval marking of the rear lamp shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.quote: This sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking of the rear lamp shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.quote: The number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.

requirements.text: If the rear lamp cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the approval marking shall include a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
requirements.quote: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.

requirements.text: If the rear lamp cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the horizontal arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of direction indicators categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12.
requirements.quote: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of: (a) Direction indicators categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12;

requirements.text: If the rear lamp cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the horizontal arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of front or rear position lamps, front or rear end-outline marker lamps.
requirements.quote: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of: (b) Front or rear position lamps, front or rear end-outline marker lamps;

requirements.text: If the rear lamp cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the horizontal arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of reversing lamps in case of reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps.
requirements.quote: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of: (c) Reversing lamps in case of reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps.

requirements.text: If applicable, the rear lamp shall bear, to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4., the additional letter "D" where the lamp may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps.
requirements.quote: If applicable, to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4.: (a) The additional letter "D", on lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps;

requirements.text: If applicable, the rear lamp shall bear, to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4., the additional letter "Y" where the lamp is used as part of an interdependent lamps system.
requirements.quote: If applicable, to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4.: (b) The additional letter "Y", on lamps which are used as part of an interdependent lamps system.

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall bear the approval marking.
requirements.quote: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.quote: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant

requirements.text: The rear lamp, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, shall bear a marking indicating the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed.
requirements.quote: Lamps shall, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, bear a marking indicating: (a) The category or categories of light source(s) prescribed;

requirements.text: The rear lamp, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, shall, in the case where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), also bear a marking indicating the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s).
requirements.quote: Lamps shall, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, bear a marking indicating: (b) in the case where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), also the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s);

requirements.text: In the case of a rear lamp with an electronic light source control gear, the rear lamp shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.quote: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with: (a) An electronic light source control gear;

requirements.text: In the case of a rear lamp with a variable luminous intensity control, the rear lamp shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.quote: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with: (b) A variable luminous intensity control;

requirements.text: In the case of a rear lamp with a secondary operating mode, the rear lamp shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.quote: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with: (c) A secondary operating mode;

requirements.text: In the case of a rear lamp with non-replaceable light sources, the rear lamp shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.quote: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with: (d) Non-replaceable light sources.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.quote: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, bear the following markings. (a) On the light source module(s): (i) The trade name or mark of the applicant;

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the specific identification code of the module, comprising the starting letters "MD" for "MODULE" followed by the approval mark without the circle as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.2.1.1.
requirements.quote: (ii) The specific identification code of the module; This specific identification code shall comprise the starting letters "MD" for "MODULE" followed by the approval mark without the circle as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.2.1.1.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used and several non-identical light source modules are used, the specific identification code of the module shall be followed by additional symbols or characters.
requirements.quote: In case several non-identical light source modules are used, followed by additional symbols or characters;

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the approval mark in the module identification code shall be from the same applicant as the approval mark on the rear lamp in which the module is used, but need not be the same mark.
requirements.quote: The approval mark does not have to be the same as the one on the lamp in which the module is used, but both marks shall be from the same applicant;

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
requirements.quote: (iii) The rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the rear lamp shall bear the specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii).
requirements.quote: (b) On the lamp: (i) The specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii);

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the rear lamp shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
requirements.quote: (b) On the lamp: (ii) The rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.

requirements.text: An electronic light source control gear being part of the rear lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.

requirements.text: A variable luminous intensity control being part of the rear lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the rear lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
requirements.quote: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.

requirements.text: In any case, the approval marking of the rear lamp shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.quote: In any case the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.

requirements.text: In any case, the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the rear lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.quote: In any case the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.

requirements.text: If the outer lens of the rear lamp is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on the detachable lens.
requirements.quote: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both, the detachable lens and the main body.

requirements.text: If the outer lens of the rear lamp is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on the main body.
requirements.quote: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both, the detachable lens and the main body.

requirements.text: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
requirements.quote: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.

requirements.text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the rear lamp.
requirements.quote: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.

requirements.text: The markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.5.(a) shall be affixed on the component.
requirements.quote: The markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.5.(a) shall be affixed on the component.

requirements.text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations and a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number is affixed, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light shall be removable without at the same time removing the approval mark.
requirements.quote: No part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark of the rear lamp shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.quote: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.

requirements.text: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.quote: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval shall apply to the rear lamp.
requirements.quote: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval shall apply to this Regulation.

requirements.text: Where verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible, the requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied to the rear lamp.
requirements.quote: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which it may be subjected in such use, its satisfactory operation remains assured.
requirements.quote: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which it may be subjected in such use, it retains the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.

requirements.text: In the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, the functions shall either be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source) or be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.
requirements.quote: However, in the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, these functions shall either: (a) be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source); or (b) be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.

requirements.text: In the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, in either case a note shall be made within the communication document.
requirements.quote: In either case, a note shall be made within the communication document.

requirements.text: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.
requirements.quote: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply: the light intensity of the rear lamp complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded.
requirements.quote: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply: (a) The light intensity complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded;

requirements.text: Where a tell-tale failure signal is produced in case of failure of any one light source, a note in the communication form shall state that the lamp is only for use on a vehicle fitted with a tell-tale indicating failure.
requirements.quote: In this case a note in the communication form states that the lamp is only for use on a vehicle fitted with a tell-tale indicating failure.

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a rear position lamp category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1, the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.quote: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of: (a) A rear position lamp category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1;

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a rear end-outline marker lamp category RM2 emitting more than the maximum value of category RM1, the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.quote: (b) A rear end-outline marker lamp category RM2 emitting more than the maximum value of category RM1;

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a stop lamp category S2 emitting more than the maximum value of category S1, the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.quote: (c) A stop lamp category S2 emitting more than the maximum value of category S1;

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a stop lamp category S4 emitting more than the maximum value of category S3, the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.quote: (d) A stop lamp category S4 emitting more than the maximum value of category S3;

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a direction indicator of category 2b emitting more than the maximum value of category 2a, the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.quote: (e) A direction indicator of category 2b emitting more than the maximum value of category 2a;

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a rear fog lamp of category F2 emitting more than the maximum value of category F1, the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.quote: (f) A rear fog lamp of category F2 emitting more than the maximum value of category F1.

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
requirements.quote: Use of light sources. The lamp shall only be equipped with: - replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or - light source module(s) and/or - non-replaceable light source(s)

requirements.text: In case a light source category or categories or type(s) is restricted for use in lamps on vehicles in use and originally equipped with such lamps, the applicant for type approval of the rear lamp shall declare that the rear lamp is only intended for installation on those vehicles.
requirements.quote: In case a light source category or categories or type(s) is restricted for use in lamps on vehicles in use and originally equipped with such lamps, the applicant for type approval of the lamp shall declare that the lamp is only intended for installation on those vehicles; this shall be noted in the communication form

requirements.text: In case a light source category or categories or type(s) is restricted for use in lamps on vehicles in use and originally equipped with such lamps, the declaration that the rear lamp is only intended for installation on those vehicles shall be noted in the communication form.
requirements.quote: In case a light source category or categories or type(s) is restricted for use in lamps on vehicles in use and originally equipped with such lamps, the applicant for type approval of the lamp shall declare that the lamp is only intended for installation on those vehicles; this shall be noted in the communication form

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the design of the rear lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
requirements.quote: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), (a) The design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one;

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed applying.
requirements.quote: (b) The light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061. The holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed, applies.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), where a category of LED substitute light source(s) is also prescribed, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of LED substitute light source(s) shall apply to the light source(s) holder.
requirements.quote: In addition, where a category of LED substitute light source(s) is also prescribed, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of LED substitute light source(s) applies.

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
requirements.quote: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that (a) it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s);

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it is tamperproof.
requirements.quote: (b) it is tamperproof;

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that, regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source and/or any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
requirements.quote: (c) regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not interchangeable with: - any replaceable UN approved light source; and/or, - any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of the rear lamp shall be met.
requirements.quote: (d) when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of device shall be met.

requirements.text: In the case of replaceable UN approved light sources, all measurements of the rear lamp shall be made using standard light sources as specified in R.E.5.
requirements.quote: In the case of replaceable UN approved light sources, all measurements shall be made using standard light sources as specified in R.E.5.

requirements.text: In the case of a rear lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the rear lamp.
requirements.quote: In the case of a lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.

requirements.text: In case of a rear lamp (function) using light sources which are subject to more than one of the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4.8., the photometric measurements shall be made separately, in accordance with each applicable condition(s) set forth in paragraph 4.8.
requirements.quote: In case of a lamp (function) using light sources which are subject to more than one of the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4.8., the photometric measurements shall be made separately, in accordance with each applicable condition(s) set forth in paragraph 4.8.

requirements.text: In case of a rear lamp (function) using light sources which are subject to more than one of the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4.8., all separate measurement results shall be added together.
requirements.quote: All separate measurement results shall be added together.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensities of the rear lamp shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.
requirements.quote: If not otherwise specified, the intensities shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.

requirements.text: In case of a rear lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the rear lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant during testing.
requirements.quote: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant;

requirements.text: The identification of an electronic light source control gear, if applicable, or variable intensity control, if applicable, of the rear lamp shall be noted in the communication form in Annex 1.
requirements.quote: The identification of an electronic light source control gear if applicable or variable intensity control if applicable and/or the voltage applied, including the tolerances, shall be noted in the communication form in Annex 1.

requirements.text: The voltage applied to the rear lamp, including the tolerances, shall be noted in the communication form in Annex 1.
requirements.quote: The identification of an electronic light source control gear if applicable or variable intensity control if applicable and/or the voltage applied, including the tolerances, shall be noted in the communication form in Annex 1.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the rear lamp shall, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.quote: (a) On the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.;

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the rear lamp shall, in no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.quote: (b) In no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum, specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.;

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the rear lamp shall, outside the reference axis, be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5., by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question.
requirements.quote: (c) Outside the reference axis, - be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5., by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question,

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, as an alternative, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the rear lamp shall, outside the reference axis, be not less than the intensity value as specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question.
requirements.quote: or - be not less than the intensity value as specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question;

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the rear lamp shall, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.quote: (d) Within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.

requirements.text: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed for the rear lamp.
requirements.quote: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.

requirements.text: If a rear position lamp and/or a rear end-outline marker lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp producing either steady or variable luminous intensity, the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously at the intensity of the rear position lamp or end-outline marker lamp when turned on alone should be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by the straight horizontal lines passing through ±5° V and the straight vertical lines passing through ±10° H of the light distribution table.
requirements.quote: If a rear position lamp and/or a rear end-outline marker lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp producing either steady or variable luminous intensity, the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously at the intensity of the rear position lamp or end-outline marker lamp when turned on alone should be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by the straight horizontal lines passing through ±5° V and the straight vertical lines passing through ±10° H of the light distribution table.

requirements.text: If one or both of the two reciprocally incorporated lamps contain(s) more than one light source and is (are) considered as a single lamp, the values to be considered shall be those obtained with all sources in operation.
requirements.quote: If the one or both of the two reciprocally incorporated lamps contain(s) more than one light source and is (are) considered as a single lamp, the values to be considered are those obtained with all sources in operation;

requirements.text: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities of the rear lamp shall be carried out according to Annex 8.
requirements.quote: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear lamp shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.
requirements.quote: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.

requirements.text: To check the colorimetric characteristics of the rear lamp, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8. shall be applied.
requirements.quote: To check these colorimetric characteristics, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8. shall be applied.

requirements.text: Outside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3, no sharp variation of colour shall be observed for the rear lamp.
requirements.quote: Outside this field no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.

requirements.text: For rear lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 4.8.

requirements.quote: For lamps (functions) using different light source technologies, the colorimetric characteristics shall be checked for each light source technology separately according to the applicable provisions in paragraphs 4.8.1. and 4.8.2.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the rear position lamp shall meet the requirements in Table 4, except that a luminous intensity of 6.0∙10^1 cd shall be permitted for rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility given in Table 4.

requirements.quote: For end-outline marker lamps (RM1, RM2) the standard light distribution may be considered at the request of the applicant from VV line to the outboard only.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall meet the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the stop lamp shall meet the requirements in Table 7.
requirements.quote: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall meet the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility given in Table 7.
requirements.quote: Minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility See Table 7.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall meet the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
requirements.quote: Failure provisions: See paragraph 4.6.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.quote: Colour: The colour of light emitted shall be red.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the reversing lamp supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 10, except that where the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices, the photometric intensity may be verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards where a photometric value of at least 2.5∙10^1 cd shall be satisfied.

requirements.text: Where the type approval is granted applying the pair-only condition, the condition shall be clearly explained in the application for approval and relating documents (see paragraph 3.1.).
requirements.quote: This condition shall be clearly explained in the application for approval and relating documents (see paragraph 3.1.).

requirements.text: Where the type approval is granted applying the pair-only condition, a statement in paragraph 9.1.3. of the communication form (see Annex 1) shall inform that the reversing lamp shall only be installed in a pair.
requirements.quote: Moreover, in the case where the type approval will be granted applying the condition above, a statement in paragraph 9.1.3. of the communication form (see Annex 1) will inform that the device shall only be installed in a pair.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp of category AR shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 8.0∙10^1 cd in or above the h-plane, in accordance with Table 10.
The reversing lamp of category AR shall have a maximum luminous intensity not exceeding 3.00∙10^2 cd in or above the h-plane, in accordance with Table 10.

The reversing lamp of category AR shall have a maximum luminous intensity not exceeding 8.00∙10^3 cd below 5°D, in accordance with Table 10.
